# Rachel Gorman

**Research Analyst · Applied Digital Sociology · Political Violence & Digital Research**

I am a research analyst specializing in mixed-methods research, data analysis, open-source investigation, and data visualization. My work focuses on political violence, far-right digital radicalization, and the relationship between digital and offline forms of violence.

**Research Analyst at the Bridging Divides Initiative**  
**M.S. Applied Digital Sociology, Hunter College**
